scripts:
create service user demo-publish-user with path system/demo
set ACL for demo-publish-user
    allow jcr:read,crx:replicate,jcr:versionManagement,jcr:modifyProperties on /content/demo
end
create service user demo-contact-service-user with forced path system/cq:services/demo

set ACL on /var/demo/contacts (ACLOptions=merge)
    allow jcr:read,rep:write for demo-contact-service-user
end
